title: Nine Migrant Bodies Recovered Off Tajoura After Boat Capsizes
detail: The Tripoli branch of the Libyan Red Crescent recovered nine bodies over two days from a wooden boat carrying an estimated 19 people that capsized off Tajoura, roughly 22km east of Tripoli. Search and recovery operations continued in coordination with security forces, with the Red Crescent warning more bodies were likely to wash ashore given the boat's passenger count. The recoveries came the same week a separate boat that left Zuwara was intercepted by the charity ship EMERGENCY, which rescued 50 migrants and recovered seven bodies from that vessel.

media.caption: Red Crescent volunteers and security forces recover migrant bodies at Tajoura beach east of Tripoli

confidenceReason: Confirmed by the Libyan Red Crescent's Tripoli branch and reported via Reuters wire, carried by multiple Tier-2 outlets.
